r: Administer, monitor, and maintain three S/4HANA 2022 on-premise systems, ensuring high availability, optimal performance, and security.
Manage SAP DMS systems running on MAXDB databases within Windows Server environments, including backup/recovery strategies, database tuning, and OS-level troubleshooting.
Perform routine tasks such as system copies, transports, kernel upgrades, support package stacks (SPS), and patch management.
Monitor system health using tools like SAP Solution Manager, DPA, or equivalent monitoring solutions; proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
Administer and configure SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) subaccounts, entitlements, and services.

Manage SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IDaaS) and SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAG) for user lifecycle management, SSO configuration, and role-based access control across hybrid environments.
Oversee the technical foundation of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and ensure secure data connectivity from on-premise sources.
Support the deployment and maintenance of other SAP Cloud applications including SuccessFactors, Ariba, Joule, and SuccessFactors Work Zone.
Collaborate with integration teams to ensure smooth technical connectivity between on-premise S/4HANA/DMS and cloud systems.
Manage technical aspects of hybrid integrations, including RFC destinations, OData services, and API management configurations.
Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity issues between SAP systems and non-SAP enterprise applications (e.g., ERP interfaces, third-party logistics, HR systems, etc.).
Ensure secure and compliant data exchange using appropriate protocols (HTTPS, SFTP, etc.) and encryption standards.
Implement and enforce SAP security best practices, including user access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), and password policies aligned with corporate security standards.
Automate routine BASIS tasks using scripts (Shell, PowerShell, ABAP) or SAP automation tools to improve efficiency and reduce manual errors.
Participate in disaster recovery planning, backup strategy validation, and business continuity testing.
Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies, particularly in cloud-native administration and hybrid landscape management.
